review_notes: Schemas 2 through 5 manifests, verifiers and reports are preserved byte-for-byte under their baseline/modernization-vN directories; the verifier pins their immutable digests. Schema 5 was archived directly from commit 1aefbe4da203115200c0720904ad23bd557974aa and records the previously tested local JAR; this historical evidence does not approve the merge.

User requested clearer true terrain relief because the existing volcanic ledges read as low walls over a flat surface. This iteration reviews the geometry shared by terrain, ramps, cliff faces, actors and camera, while retaining saved tile/route identity and gameplay collision rules.

User requested structural biome/environment replacement, corrected night ghost presentation, stable world/ability/battle transitions, full Pokemon summaries, coherent desktop controls/UI and habitat-correct wild encounters.
Protected original Attack, Battle, Player, Network, Save, CheckMovesLearned, CheckEndOfBattle, PkmnMap and DrawSetupMenu remain byte-identical to the classic 198-source baseline.

BiomeProfiles is shared by atlas mapping, world atmosphere/geometry, battle scenery and WildSpawnRules. Terrain geometry is a read-only sidecar from existing ledges/ramps; no Tile or serialized network/save height fields are introduced.

Wild selection changes only new wild paths and natural evolution habitat checks. Intentional empty routes stay empty; explicit safe species are used for nonempty invalid candidate pools. Unique generated oasis Milotic retains identity and is anchored to water if necessary.

Milotic was missing from the original swim-only species list. Profile-required aquatic species now stay in water when uncaught; previousOwner companions retain original movement. Existing saves are not rewritten or migrated.

WorldElevation solves stable per-tile weighted constraints with a disjoint-set structure. Saved ledges take priority over ramp and flat continuation evidence; shared corner heights match the renderer triangulation. Only a single-cell walkable opening bounded by immediate, concordant saved ledges gains an inferred ramp. Conflicting terrain constraints are diagnosed locally; no terrain height, collision or save data is written.
GenIsland1 explicitly rejects and retries a randomly generated mansion layout with no legal endpoint, within the existing four-attempt retry limit. Other exceptions keep their original diagnostics.

Original map actions still execute; WorldBatch suppresses only their legacy pixel submissions. The night ghost is an intentional game encounter, drawn as a modern wisp without changing spawn timing, encounters or hidden identity.

Native tests cover actual PlayerStanding wild selection and Pokemon.FollowPath water movement, complete animation bounds, expanded viewport/UI layouts, field actions, scene transitions, procedural generation and save/load. Physical controller hardware and complete playthroughs are not implied.

Final same-save review: contextual mansion approach materials preserve saved encounter routes; tidal/puddle overlays retain visible shallow beds; grass ledges use ground material. Native regression capture preserves every saved-file hash.

Schema 6 adds VisualSampling and VisualGeometry to the exact source allowlist (218 total sources); it reviews merged BwAssets, JohtoRenderer and PmdBattleSprites against the immutable schema 5 checkpoint. No saved terrain height, collision or battle-rule changes are authorized by this merge.

VisualSampling validates complete source-cell coverage and maps signed world coordinates to pixel samples independently of the 16-unit simulation grid. VisualGeometry provides diagonal facing, uniform sprite fit, building classification and pure cliff footprint helpers; retaining a helper does not require replacing the reviewed WorldElevation-derived surfaces.

The complete merge delta against schema 5 is exactly BwAssets, JohtoRenderer and PmdBattleSprites plus the two new helpers. The other 213 previously reviewed sources, including WorldElevation and all protected originals, are unchanged.

Coordinated source-mode native QA passed terrain relief, biome scenes, 183 PMD battle draws with diagonal-pose bounds, and GPU asset integration (7,967 checks; 202 complete regions; 48 animation frames). Renderer-specific checks passed HD trainer scaling, proportional field-pose crops, normalized anchors and shifted shadows. These source-mode results do not substitute for separate rebuilt-JAR validation.

The renderer retains WorldElevation-derived surfaces and edge faces; the imported cliff footprint helper does not reinstate the former flat-ground wall approximation. Full cliff artwork is sampled vertically, and known floors/props are classified without replacing them with building walls.

Normal verification and --inventory never refresh approved hashes. The frozen manifest and complete source patch bind the exact coordinated final sources; source scope alone does not validate resource bytes, packaging or visual behavior.
